blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will see a significant drop in fuel pump prices, particularly gasoline, reaching up to nearly P17 per liter this week. In a media briefing, Department of Energy (DOE) Secretary Sharon Garin said gasoline prices would decline by at least P16.80 per liter starting Nov. 10. READ: US midterm results may cut fuel prices by up to P13.50/L This marks the first time gasoline logged a double-digit decrease since the Middle East war began.
